title: DeepSeek Releases V4-Pro (1.6T Parameters) Built on Huawei Ascend 950 Chips, Challenging US AI Dominance
detail: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek released a preview of V4-Pro (1.6 trillion parameters) and V4-Flash (284 billion parameters) on April 24, 2026, both under the MIT open-source license with 1-million-token context windows. Critically, both models were trained entirely on Huawei Ascend 950 chips via domestic 'Supernode' cluster architecture — demonstrating China's capacity to develop frontier AI without Nvidia H100/H800 GPUs subject to US export controls. China's state AI fund (Big Fund) announced an up-to-$4 billion investment round backing DeepSeek. SMIC and Hua Hong Semiconductor shares surged 9% and 15% respectively on the news. The release prompted the Council on Foreign Relations to describe V4 as signaling 'a new phase in the US-China AI rivalry,' with independent benchmarks showing V4-Pro matching or exceeding GPT-4o on major tasks.

title: PLA Southern Theater Command Conducts Live Exercises East of Luzon Strait in Response to US-Philippines Balikatan 2026
detail: China's PLA Southern Theater Command announced on April 24, 2026 that a surface task group comprising a Type 055 destroyer, Type 052D destroyer, Type 054A frigate, and Type 903A replenishment vessel conducted live-fire exercises east of the Luzon Strait. The exercises were explicitly framed as a response to the US-Philippines Balikatan 2026 exercise — the largest annual bilateral military exercise in history — which for the first time included Japan, Australia, Canada, France, and New Zealand alongside US and Philippine forces. The exercises coincided with China's Liaoning aircraft carrier transiting the Taiwan Strait and subsequently joining a PLAN task group deploying into the Philippine Sea. The AEI China-Taiwan Update described the deployments as 'more than a routine drill,' noting the simultaneous Liaoning transit was timed to signal China's ability to project power on multiple axes.
